O.outcome_detail: Full-time immediate two-year college enrollment rate

cells.quote: There was a larger difference between the full-time immediate enrollment rates: 17.6 percent of students attempted at least 12 credit hours in the fall 2012 according to their ICCB records, while the NSC data contained full-time enrollment for only 12.9 percent of the students.
cells.note: The study suggests that full-time status may be determined at different points in the term across the datasets.

O.outcome_detail: Any two-year credential completion within four years

cells.quote: For the 3,660 students who were immediate two-year enrollees according to both datasets, the two datasets showed a similar rate of completion of any credential within four years: 18.6 percent of the students completed any credential within four years according to the ICCB data, and 17.3 percent completed any credential within four years according to the NSC data.
cells.note: The outcome is reported for students identified as immediate enrollees in both datasets.

O.outcome_detail: Associate degree completion within four years

cells.quote: When we look more closely at credential types in Table 4, the ICCB data shows a rate of associate degree completion of 14.1 percent (515 of 3,660 immediate enrollees), while only 3.7 percent of students earned a credential that could be identified as an associate degree in the NSC data (136 of 3,660 immediate enrollees).
cells.note: The contrast reflects missing or uncategorizable credential information in NSC data, not a difference in students' actual outcomes.

result.effect: mediation reported; no printed effect size

cells.quote: In a mixed-methods study of 325 in-service teachers across 26 countries, Mohebi and ElSayary (2026) report that technological pedagogical knowledge mediates the relationship between technological knowledge and overall generative-AI competence, indicating that technical fluency is converted into professional competence through pedagogical integration rather than operating alongside it as a co-equal predictor.
cells.note: Conceptual article reporting findings from a cited mixed-methods study.

result.effect: ethical dimension lowest-rated; no printed effect size

cells.quote: Structural analyses of TPACK and AI-TPACK components similarly show that integration-level and ethics- related knowledge lag behind technological knowledge among pre-service teachers, implying an internal ordering of knowledge and evaluative judgement rather than a flat set of parallel inputs (Celik, 2023; Karataş and Ataç, 2025).
cells.note: The contrast is reported narratively across cited structural analyses.

D.comparison: speech overheard by the child at 19 months

result.effect: child-directed speech r = 0.57, p < 0.01; overheard speech r = 0.25, p = 0.2

cells.quote: Those children who heard more child-directed speech at 19 months had larger vocabularies at 24 months (r = 0.57, p < 0.01), consistent with previous findings linking caregiver speech and vocabulary development in low-SES children (Hurtado et al., 2008; Pan et al., 2005). In contrast, differences in exposure to overheard speech directed to other adults and children were not related to vocabulary size (r = .25, p = .2), suggesting that language spoken directly to the child is more supportive of early lexical development than speech simply overheard by the child.
cells.note: The contrast is between two measured types of language exposure; the study did not randomly assign speech exposure.
